🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Stadt (Around the city)

das Geschäft = shop
der Bahnhof = train station
die Straße = street
der Park = park
die Brücke = bridge
die Ampel = traffic light

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
